# dagsterplus_service_user (Data Source)

Reads an existing Dagster+ service user by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "dagsterplus_service_user" "ci_bot" {
  name = "ci-bot"
}

output "service_user_id" {
  value = data.dagsterplus_service_user.ci_bot.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the service user to look up.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) The service user description.
- `id` (String) The service user ID assigned by Dagster+.
